Ava (CS): Quick heads-up — Lighthouse dedicated pool go-live target is Tue 09:00 UTC. Need final sign-off on quota split, autoscale windows, and a smoke/dryrun plan. Who can own the Monday 06:00 PST dryrun?
Rohit (SRE): I can run the smoke. Need the traffic templates and expected p95 targets. Also please confirm budgeted burst capacity (we need that for autoscale thresholds).
Maya (CSM): Customer (Lighthouse Inc) needs p95 < 150ms for inference routes and < 50ms for embeddings. They flagged renewal conditional on meeting those numbers.
Derek (Eng): On the autoscale side we have two knobs: min_reserved=4 and burst_pool=8. Proposal: min=4, target_concurrency=80, scale_up_step=2, cooldown=60s. Works?
Ava (CS): Sounds reasonable. @Rohit can you validate that with the load profile? Also we should split quota: 75% inference, 25% embeddings for the reserved pool.
Rohit (SRE): Will validate. Can someone paste the k6 test we plan to run?
Derek (Eng): Pasting the k6 ramp we discussed:
```
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 10m --rps 200 loadtests/lighthouse-ramp.js
# ramp: 20 -> 50 vus over 5m, steady 5m
```
Rohit (SRE): OK. I'll run that at Mon 13:00 UTC (06:00 PST) against staging-reserved. ops-bot: please create a ticket and trigger the test run.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-8921 and queued loadtest job 8921. Test scheduled Mon 13:00 UTC.
Eli (Support): I'll be on standby for any quota errors (401/429) and to collect logs. Please add my slack handle to the test ticket.
Maya (CSM): I'm going to send the customer the revised quota split and ask them to confirm the traffic mix by EOD today. If they don't confirm, renewal risk increases.
Ava (CS): Action items: 1) @Rohit run k6 on Mon 13:00 UTC; 2) @Derek validate autoscale params against load output; 3) @Eli capture error logs and token-level cost during test; 4) @Maya get customer confirmation on mix. I'll collate results and aim for sign-off Mon afternoon. :memo:
Rohit (SRE): Noted. Quick note — we'll enable prefix KV cache for inference to reduce token work; it may change latency curves. I'll capture with and without cache.
Derek (Eng): Good call. For metrics capture, use this prometheus query for p95:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
Rohit (SRE): Bringing up test now requires a short warmup for the GPUs. I'll warm the pool 30m prior. ops-bot: update ticket with warmup window.
ops-bot: Updated CS-8921: warmup window set to 30m prior to test.
Maya (CSM): Customer asked for a dry-run recording for their SREs. Can we capture a short run and share the k6 artifact?
Derek (Eng): Yes — we'll upload the k6 summary and flamegraphs to the ticket.
Ava (CS): If Monday run looks good -> plan for Tue 09:00 UTC cutover to reserved pool with step traffic shift of 10% every 5m. If we see latency regressions or >5% error rate, we pause and roll back.
Eli (Support): I'll create a simple runbook snippet for the cutover steps and remediation (rollback to hosted variant).
Maya (CSM): I'll loop in customer execs once we have the Monday results.
Rohit (SRE): One more ask — please approve the temporary burst capacity charge for that week in billing so we don't hit quota blocks during test.
Ava (CS): Approved for the experiment week. :thumbsup:
Derek (Eng): I'll be available Mon and Tue morning.
Ava (CS): Great — thanks everyone. Will post final checklist and test link in this thread after the run.
Maya (CSM): Thanks — adding the outcome to the renewal tracker regardless.
ops-bot: Loadtest job 8921 started (Mon 13:00 UTC).
